items.title: What Will It Look Like If Investment in Learner Wallets Pays Off?
items.contentSnippet: What if a 12-year-old's sketching habit, a 19-year-old's gap year travels, and a 45-year-old's volunteer coordination all counted as verifiable learning? In a new piece for Getting Smart, Mason Pashia explores three fictional case studies — Leo, Jamie, and Elena — that bring the Gates Foundation's LearnKit framework to life, showing what learner-owned digital records could actually look like in practice.
